download_scope: Fresh shallow sparse checkout of code directories dc_decomposition, difference_of_networks, util, xai and top-level files; experiment artifact directories omitted.

findings.old_execution: Separate HybridTCSplitNetwork built from planned replacement chunks; forward resolves original graph inputs with ResidualCache; reverse pass explicitly accumulates four sensitivity components in input_caches.
findings.current_execution: Existing supported modules get patched forwards backed by custom autograd.Function backward methods. FX preprocessing converts functional calls into modules and recompiles forwards; this is not a graph-free implementation.
findings.layout: Packed along dimension 0: shape [4B,...], channels and parameter shapes unchanged. init_catted gives [pos,neg,0,0]; intermediate make_output_4 gives [pos,neg,pos,neg]. Backward packs four sensitivities.
findings.native_add: Corresponding packed blocks add under ordinary +, and PyTorch autograd distributes and accumulates gradients. Verified without FX or custom Add on 6 small residual networks.
findings.prepared_add: Default functional conversion inserts Add(recenter=True), with custom autograd for re-centering, optional alignment and sensitivity shifts. The custom Add is therefore present in this checkout, though not algebraically necessary for split+split residual sums.
findings.remaining_caches: Optional original-value/gradient alignment captures and custom-autograd saved tensors remain; removal of old explicit residual-routing cache does not mean cache-free.
findings.transformer_scope: Current bwgame softmax and LayerNorm use value-recovering splits, not the thesis globally convex/monotone Transformer construction. The transformer-dc experimental branch remains a separate graph/chunk implementation.
findings.notation_note: Several helper docstrings describe zeros in the trailing quarters where their implementations actually duplicate the streams; analysis follows executable code.

manuscript_scope: Comparison now incorporated in Section subsec:split_implementations of Chapter 03 at the author's request; see manuscript-review.json.
